title: bounded Turbo4 page-wave prefill
hypothesis: The three-query prefill cap and synchronize-after-every-ubatch policy serialized paged prefill and caused the observed sub-20-token/s selective path.

changed_variable.synchronization: fence before advancing at contiguous page ends and once at the final tile; no fence between tiles within a page wave

implementation.prefill_planner: bounded Turbo4 query tiles use the physical page budget and a 16-token direct-kernel limit
implementation.cuda_kernel: Turbo4 paged query-tile validation, shared memory, online-softmax state, causal mask, and dispatcher support 1..16 queries
implementation.fallback: unsupported direct query tiles remain selected-reference and expose reason 'bounded Turbo4 selected reference for unsupported direct query tile'
implementation.live_capability: The model-backed selective probe did not satisfy the direct live capability predicate, so the measured live route was selected-reference; no direct speed claim is made.

tests.coverage: planner tiles 1/3/8/16/32, selected-reference reason, CUDA query tiles through 16, unsupported 17/32, page tails, logical gaps, native positions/masks, page mass, partial state, and split-wave merge

benchmark.request: single deterministic x-token prompt, max_tokens=1, temperature=0, seed=42, native GPU MTP, context 22016, page size 256
benchmark.interpretation: The page-wave fence is bounded by page waves (18 waits for 4148 tokens) rather than one wait per token. Selective remains a slow reference fallback on this live model; this task does not claim the speed target.

deferred: A direct live-model route was not observable because the existing runtime capability predicate rejected the model-backed direct binding; 21-03 owns cold-page promotion/selective routing follow-up.
The 8K selective reference probe exceeded its explicit 750-second diagnostic bound; no selective 8K throughput or correctness result is claimed.
No corpus campaign was run; full-context and production-quality measurements remain later-task work.
